Q.name: Tumble
Q.title: Template:Data Vayne/Tumble
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Tumble|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Vayne
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Tumble.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vayne}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction. Her next {{tip|basic attack}} within a few seconds will deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vayne''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the target direction, though not through terrain, and empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 3 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|75 to 115}}% AD}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|description2 = ''Tumble {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Vayne's''' basic attack timer.''
|range        = {{tt|300|Dash distance}}
|speed        = {{tt|500 + {{as|100% movement speed}}|Dash speed}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|6 to 2}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = {{ap|46 to 30}}
|cast time    = none
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = [[Self-targeted|Self]]
|damagetype   = physical
|projectile   = 
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = 
|grounded = true
|knockdown = true
|parry        = True
|notes        = 
{{always quickcast}}
* The basic attack portion of ''Tumble's'' damage is tagged as {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}, while the bonus damage is tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* The bonus damage applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
* Although ''Tumble'' will reset the basic attack timer, '''Vayne''' cannot attack until the animation is complete.
* '''Vayne''' can cast {{ai|Final Hour|Vayne}} during ''Tumble''. She does not become {{tip|invisible}} during the dash.
}}

W.name: Silver Bolts
W.title: Template:Data Vayne/Silver Bolts
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Silver Bolts|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Vayne
|skill        = W
|icon         = Silver Bolts.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Vayne}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Condemn|Vayne}}'' will apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Silver Bolts'', which expires upon attacking a new enemy.
|blurb2      = The third stack will consume them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vayne's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Condemn|Vayne}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Silver Bolts'' for {{fd|3.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications, expiring upon attacking a new enemy, and stacking up to 3 times. 
|description2 = The third stack consumes them all to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}, with a minimum threshold.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus True Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 10}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
{{st|Minimum Bonus Damage|{{ap|40 to 100}}}}
|description3 = ''Silver Bolts'' deals modified damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
|leveling3    = {{st|Monster Damage|{{ap|140 to 200}}}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = true
|spelleffects = Proc
|parry = true
|spellshield  = False
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Stacks}} are not removed if '''Vayne''' switches to attacking a target immune to ''Silver Bolts'' ({{tip|structures}}, {{tip|wards}}).
* ''Silver Bolts'' do not apply to additional targets with {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}.
* The stacks can be consumed even if the target is in {{tip|stasis}}.
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Vayne_Original_LevelUpW_0.ogg}} ''"Purge with silver."''
}}

E.name: Condemn
E.title: Template:Data Vayne/Condemn
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Condemn|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Vayne
|skill        = E
|icon         = Condemn.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Vayne}} fires a heavy bolt at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}}.
|blurb2      = If the target hits [[terrain]], they are briefly {{tip|stun|stunned}} and dealt {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vayne''' fires a heavy bolt at the target enemy that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} 475 units, though not through terrain.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|50 to 190}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description2 = If the target collides with [[terrain]], they take {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}|physical}} and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{ap|1.5}} seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|50*1.5 to 190*1.5}} {{as|(+ 75% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|50*2.5 to 190*2.5}} {{as|(+ 125% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|target range = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 550
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|2200|Missile speed}}|{{tt|2000|Knockback speed}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|20 to 12}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = 90
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = physical
|projectile   = true
|spelleffects = spell
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = True
|callforhelp  = True
|notes        = 
* ''Condemn's'' {{tip|airborne|displacement}} direction is determined at the end of the cast time.
** Because of this, '''Vayne''' may use {{si|Flash}} during the cast time to create a better angle.
* {{tip|Cleanse|Cleansing}} the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} will also end the displacement early.
* The [[spell indicator]] for this ability also displays the direction for the knock back relative to '''Vayne's''' position.
* ''Condemn's'' {{tip|stun}} duration starts when '''Vayne's''' target collides with a wall (they can be immobilized for up to 2 seconds depending on {{tip|airborne|displacement}} duration based on distance traveled).
* ''Condemn's'' missile will fail to fire if '''Vayne''' is {{tip|suppression|suppressed}} during the cast time.{{bug|2}}
* ''Condemn'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
}}

|blurb3       = Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} extends ''Final Hour's'' duration.

{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{ap|35 to 65 3}}}}

Additionally, ''{{ais|Tumble|Vayne}}'' cast grants '''Vayne''' {{tip|invisibility}} for 1 second. Attacking or casting abilities ends the stealth immediately.
